prompt: Camera dips and clips through the ground when the player lands

what: Follows the target's offset position with SmoothDamp on the horizontal axes, but drives Y with a separate lerp that uses landingDipDamping while the player is airborne.
why: One SmoothDamp for all three axes overshot on landing: the camera kept falling after the capsule stopped, which is what read as clipping through the ground.

what: Draws the follow target, the desired camera position and a ray whose length is proportional to landingDipDamping, while this camera is selected.
why: The vertical split is invisible at runtime, so tuning landingDipDamping meant guessing; the gizmo makes the value visible in the scene view.

what: Raises the shake amplitude to the requested amount and never lowers it, so overlapping shakes take the loudest rather than summing.
why: Read while working out whether the landing dip should route through this component instead. It should not: the dip is continuous and this is impulse-driven.
